commercial_provenance.basis: Internal point-in-time FSFFL league trade history supports meaningful package concentration without relying on restricted proprietary historical value tables.
commercial_provenance.evidence_summary: Across the augmented historical sample, the strong curve outperformed center, mild, and additive treatment overall, in the earlier training period, in the later holdout period, across one-for-many, many-for-one, and many-for-many topologies, across bounded FAAB sensitivity, and under leave-one-manager-out checks.
commercial_provenance.update_rule: Continue challenger calibration in the research workstream. Replace the active curve when a challenger demonstrates a materially better and robust out-of-sample fit across temporal holdout, topology, uncertainty, manager-influence, provenance, and governance gates.

principle: Package concentration replaces raw additive package treatment inside FUTURE ASSET VALUE; it is not an added fifth channel. The active strong curve is evidence-backed but is not claimed to be the final point-optimal curve.
center_derivation: Arithmetic midpoint of the inherited mild and strong FSFFL package curves.

tail_policy.strong: continue -0.06 per additional asset to floor 0.28
tail_policy.center: arithmetic midpoint of mild and strong tail weights

promotion_evidence.strong_vs_center_summary: Strong reduced weighted absolute clearing distance by about ten and a half percent versus center in the primary augmented comparison.
promotion_evidence.strong_vs_additive_summary: Strong reduced weighted absolute clearing distance by about twenty-nine and seven-tenths percent versus additive treatment in the primary augmented comparison.
